{{Quote|That Transport Commission processing agent expressed a desire for "bonus pay," did he? How amusing. What was his name? Merlyx Dolv?|Daclif Gallamby|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Merlyx Dolv''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] processing [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Transport Commission]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorSecTrooperFemaleTemplate.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Randomly generated female depictions of Merlyx Dolv, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Merlyx Dolv was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Merlyx Dolv spawned under the generic "corsec_agent" template, his appearance was randomized under one of four possible depictions. He could either appear as a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Human male wearing either an [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] or a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], or as a brown haired, brown eyed Human female wearing either the officer's uniform or pilot's jumpsuit. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Dolv as male, this article assumes that the Human male depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. However, the type of clothing he wore cannot be definitively determined.<ref name="AED" />
